applies_to.new_language_pair: en-de GRPO with XCOMET-XL-QE, CometKiwi-22, CometKiwi-23-XL, MetricX-24-QE (seed 0 first; 3 seeds if resources allow); audit statistics stay those from the 3 non-en-de pools, so en-de also tests cross-language transfer of the audit
applies_to.new_reward: MetricX-24-hybrid in QE mode (src/metricx_qe.py), GRPO en-es, seeds 0-2

audit_statistic: For degeneration type k, d_k = fraction of segments (pooled over the v1 T4 items: WMT23 zh-en, WMT24 ja-zh, WMT24 en-es; results/llm_judge_protocol_amendment_1.json) on which the reward scores the degenerate text strictly below the best human-rated candidate.
retrospective_fit_disclosure: The thresholds were chosen after the en-es pilot. On the pilot they give: XCOMET-XL copy hack predicted (d=0.165, observed), CometKiwi-23-XL copy-safe (d=0.987, observed), CometKiwi-22 no copy prediction (d=0.71). The pilot is therefore not evidence for the rule; only new rewards (MetricX-24-QE) and the new language pair (en-de) test it.

rule.otherwise: no prediction for that type; outcome reported
